Version: 0.2 | Updated: 2026-09-09 | Status: Template

## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change makes possible.

## Authority and scope

Link the task, mandate, affected policy, and any required decision.

## Validation

Record actual checks, outcomes, and remaining limits.

## Operational considerations

Describe migration, monitoring, rollback, customer impact, and any autonomy failure or human dependency introduced.

## Review

Identify independent review requirements and whether this changes governance.
